target_symbols: TokenType additions: TOKEN_PLUS_EQ, TOKEN_MINUS_EQ, TOKEN_STAR_EQ, TOKEN_SLASH_EQ, TOKEN_PERCENT_EQ, TOKEN_FOR, TOKEN_IN, TOKEN_BREAK, TOKEN_CONTINUE
behavior_constraints: String literals interpret newline, tab, backslash, and double-quote escape sequences rather than copying backslashes literally.
Comparison operators (==, !=, <, >, <=, >=) have lower precedence than + and -, so a + b == c parses as (a + b) == c.
Nested function calls used as call arguments evaluate correctly; add(double(3), triple(2)) returns the expected result without stack corruption.
All existing test programs in /app/tests produce output matching their .expected files.

C-style for (init; cond; step) { body } loops execute init once, test cond before each iteration, run step after body/continue; a let in init is loop-scoped and invisible afterward, while an assignment to an existing variable persists after the loop.
break exits the innermost while or for loop; continue skips to the next iteration; in C-style for, continue jumps to step then re-evaluates cond.

Compound operators +=, -=, *=, /=, and %= update simple local or global variables; += concatenates strings, the other compound operators apply to integers only, and none apply to array element access.
for (x in arr) { body } iterates array elements and binds x as a loop-local each iteration; break and continue work inside it.
New constructs compose correctly: break affects only the innermost loop, and compound assignments in for step expressions respect fixed precedence.
entities.summary: Round 1 fixes lexer string escapes, comparison precedence, and nested-call stack corruption while adding C-style for loops, break/continue, compound assignment operators, and for..in array iteration.

instruction_head:
`/app` contains `minicc`, a bytecode compiler and stack-based VM for a small programming language called Mini. It compiles `.mini` source files and executes them. Build with `make` in `/app`.

The test suite in `/app/tests/` has several programs with expected outputs, but some are failing. The programs prefixed with `todo_` demonstrate broken behavior:

- String escape sequences (`\n`, `\t`, `\\`, `\"`) are not being processed — the lexer copies backslash characters literally instead of interpre
